dict.string: ForeverFit connects to the ForeverBand wearable to monitor vital signs, environment, and motion telemetry in real time.
ForeverFit communicates with your ESP32 ForeverBand to stream vitals and synchronize clock and settings.
Allows scanning medical prescriptions and lab reports for AI health analysis.
ForeverFit requires background location to transmit precise coordinates to responders in the event of an automated fall alert.
ForeverFit uses your location to deliver hyper-local disaster alerts, seismic warnings, and automated emergency SOS dispatch.
Captures spoken questions for real-time speech-to-text with the on-device AI assistant.
ForeverFit utilizes motion sensors for 20Hz continuous fall detection, activity recognition, and step counting.
Select medical records and images for health report insights.
Enables hands-free voice commands and queries with the AI Health Companion.
